test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that changes the form of narration in the following sentence.**

My father said, “Change is the only constant in life.”

options.text: My father said that change was the only constant in life.
My father said that change is the only constant in life.
My father had said that change was the only constant in life.
My father advised that change had been the only constant in life.

solution:
The correct answer is **"****My father said that change is the only constant in life."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rules for changing **Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:**
 
• The given sentence is in the **Present Simple Tense**.
 
• The statement "Change is the only constant in life" is a universal truth.
 
• In indirect speech, the word **“that”** is used when commas and inverted commas are removed.
 
• We don’t make any changes in the sentence with universal truth in indirect speech.
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *He said, “Earth is a planet”(Direct speech)*
 
• *He said that Earth is a planet. (Indirect speech)*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

**Correct sentence: ***My father said that change is the only constant in life.*
